dialogues: It outputs the following: «Reality is that which, when you stop believing in it, doesn't go away.»
I don't know how this house appeared or who it belongs to.
But one way or another, I live in this house now.
I still can't quite finish reading this book.
I've even forgotten what it's called.
«I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream»
Sooner or later, I'll finish reading it.
